nodes.description: Public uint256 state variable capping the maximum token ID at 8888.
Private mapping(uint256 => uint256) storing the block.timestamp recorded for each minted tokenId, used as a pseudo-random seed.
ERC721 mapping tracking the token balance of each address; incremented on mint and decremented on burn/transfer.
ReentrancyGuard status variable (_NOT_ENTERED/_ENTERED) protecting nonReentrant functions.
Public nonReentrant mint function; computes tokenId from totalSupply()+1, checks maxLimit, writes block.timestamp into numbers and calls _safeMint to msg.sender.
View function assembling the on-chain SVG/JSON metadata for a tokenId; calls getBackGround, getFiveElements, getGossip, getTenDry, geTearthlyBranch and Base64.encode.
Internal view helper that reads numbers[tokenId] and selects an element from a source array using a keccak-based pseudo-random number.
Public view function returning a Color struct chosen pseudo-randomly from numbers[tokenId].
Internal pure function computing uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(input))).
Internal ERC721 mint that calls _mint and then _checkOnERC721Received, triggering a callback to the recipient contract.
Private function performing an external call to IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received on the recipient address when it is a contract.
Internal ERC721 mint updating _balances and _owners for the given tokenId.
Public view function returning a five-element string for the tokenId via pluck.
Caller-controlled address used as the mint recipient in claim and as the spender in approval checks.
Miner-influenceable timestamp stored into numbers[tokenId] and used as the pseudo-random seed source.
Arithmetic addition derived from totalSupply() used as the new token ID in claim.
External call to an untrusted recipient contract during safe minting, executed after state updates in _mint but with reentrancy surface.
Arithmetic balance increment performed during minting in _mint.
Storage write of the untrusted block.timestamp into the numbers mapping, creating timestamp dependency.
Parameter of tokenURI and related view helpers identifying the queried token.
Local variable in claim holding totalSupply()+1 that becomes the newly minted token ID.
Recipient address parameter of _mint/_safeMint.
Bytes/string parameter of the pure random helper used as keccak input.
Local variable in pluck holding numbers[tokenId], the seed base for element selection.

edges.reason: block.timestamp is read and written into storage, making the mint seed depend on a miner-influenceable value.
claim writes block.timestamp into numbers[tokenId], introducing timestamp dependency in minting.
claim computes tokenId as totalSupply()+1, an unchecked addition feeding the token ID allocation.
claim reads maxLimit to enforce the 8888 token cap.
claim calls _safeMint to mint the new token to msg.sender.
claim reaches the untrusted onERC721Received external call through _safeMint, exposing a reentrancy path.
msg.sender is passed as the recipient address to _safeMint.
The local tokenId in claim is the result of the totalSupply()+1 arithmetic.
_safeMint calls _mint to write ownership state before the receiver callback.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received which performs the external callback.
_checkOnERC721Received performs the untrusted external onERC721Received call.
_mint increments _balances[to] by 1, an arithmetic balance update.
_mint writes the recipient balance in _balances.
The to parameter flows into _mint as the balance recipient.
tokenURI calls getBackGround to obtain the Color struct used for SVG rendering.
tokenURI calls getFiveElements to embed the five-elements character.
tokenURI indirectly depends on pluck via the get* helpers.
getBackGround calls random with a prefix and tokenId+number.
getBackGround reads numbers[tokenId] as the randomness seed.
pluck calls random to derive the array index.
pluck reads numbers[tokenId] to build the random seed.
The local number read from numbers[tokenId] flows through pluck's selection logic.
The input parameter is hashed by random to produce the pseudo-random uint256.
The tokenId parameter is the identifier used by tokenURI to fetch metadata.
The tokenId parameter is forwarded to getBackGround for lookup.
The tokenId parameter is forwarded into pluck's seed computation.
The nonReentrant modifier backed by _status guards claim against reentrant entry.

normalization_plan.reason: The tokenId parameter is only meaningful as the identifier consumed by the tokenURI metadata function and its helpers.
The local tokenId in claim is the direct result of the totalSupply()+1 arithmetic and is consumed only by claim.
The to parameter exists solely as the mint recipient used inside _mint/_safeMint.
The input parameter is only used as the hashing input of the pure random helper.
The local number variable is only a transient holder of numbers[tokenId] inside pluck.
